overview_description.description:
Muqawiloon.com is an online tendering and procurement platform to solve the dilemma facing both homeowners and construction managers when sourcing products and services for their projects through a highly automated, well-vetted​ referral system. It helps in finding and hiring the most qualified businesses and professionals for building and construction projects.

It was founded in 2016 and is headquartered in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia.

product.name: Online Tendering and Procurement Platform
product.description: A digital platform connecting homeowners and construction managers with contractors, suppliers, and professionals for project tendering and procurement.

product.name: Contractor and Supplier Listings
product.description: A categorized directory of contractors, suppliers, and specialists offering construction-related services and materials.

product.name: Project Posting and Quotation Service
product.description: A service allowing users to post construction projects and receive multiple quotations from listed businesses.

product.name: Business Profile Management
product.description: A service for businesses to create and manage professional profiles showcasing their services and qualifications.

product.name: Project Documentation and Review System
product.description: A system for documenting project progress, rating service providers, and sharing project outcomes.
